Gan is one of the tiefling refugees sheltering at the Emerald Grove in Act One.
“
Don't worry about us. I'll stab anyone who sneaks in.
„
— Gan

Involvement

Act One

Gan is usually in the training area of the Grove alongside  Ide and  Umi. He is seemingly bored of training dummies and eager to practise on real goblins. The party can encourage or discourage him and the other children during an interaction with  Asharak.

If the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving  Kagha's ritual the Rite of Thorns, the tieflings are expelled from the Emerald Grove and Gan's murdered corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village.

Idle banter

If the Grove prepares for a goblin raid during Act One, Gan and Ide 'protect' one of the entrances to the Tiefling Hideout:

  • Gan
    I'm gonna kill five goblins!
  • Ide
    So? I can take ten!
  • Gan
    Then I'll take a hundred!
  • Ide
    You can't even count to a hundred.
  • Gan
    I don't have to count. I just have to hit 'em.
